content: Vitest latest major is v4 (4.1.10 per npm registry). Default coverage provider is v8 via @vitest/coverage-v8; since v3.2 it uses AST-based remapping giving Istanbul-accurate reports at V8 speed. v4 removed coverage.all (define coverage.include explicitly), added ignoreClassMethods support and restored ignore start/stop comment support in 4.1.
